row.evidence: Trainual's pricing page lists Single sign-on (SSO) under Premium and API access under Enterprise, and its SSO guides say "You must add users to your Trainual account for them to actively use SSO"; no SCIM endpoint is documented in the help centre or the v3 API reference.
row.notes: No SCIM: SSO (Okta OIDC, Entra and Google app registrations) only signs in users who already exist, so there is no JIT either. Users can be created, updated and archived through the v3 REST API (bearer token; Premium and Enterprise training plans per the help centre, Enterprise per the pricing table) and synced from HRIS/payroll systems (all plans; archiving offboarded users is an admin step). No public prices: every plan card says 'Get a demo'.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Help centre says API on Premium; pricing table lists API access under Enterprise only (see conflicts).

scim.notes: Not documented anywhere searched; available=false reflects absence (no SCIM in help-centre sitemap or search, nor in the v3 OpenAPI spec), not an explicit 'no'.

capabilities.notes: assign_roles = the user 'permission' attribute (billing_admin, admin, author, contributor, general).

endpoints.purpose: Update user; archived=true archives, archived=false restores

audit_log_api.notes: Activities endpoints expose user activity data; no audit-log API as such is documented.

rate_limits.text: 20 requests/second per account (shared across tokens) plus 25 requests/second per IP.

okta.notes: Customer creates an Okta OIDC app integration; no OIN listing found (okta.com/integrations/trainual/ 404; OIN search 'trainual' returned no results).

entra.notes: Customer registers Trainual in Entra; no Entra gallery entry in the SaaS-apps TOC.

google.notes: Customer registers Trainual in Google Cloud for Google SSO.

fallbacks.other_sync: Native HRIS/payroll integrations (ADP, BambooHR, Gusto, Rippling, Workday, UKG and others) on all plans; archiving offboarded users is reviewed by an admin
